sql: SELECT (SELECT status FROM platform_revisions WHERE id=11) AS new_rev_status, (SELECT coalesce(activated_at::text,'NULL') FROM platform_revisions WHERE id=11) AS new_rev_activated, (SELECT r.status||' since '||r.activated_at::text FROM platform_revisions r JOIN platform_components c ON c.id=r.component_id WHERE c.key='MARKET_TAXONOMY' AND r.version='coverage_2026_08_13') AS predecessor, (SELECT count(*)::text FROM platform_impact_actions WHERE revision_id=11) AS impact_rows, (SELECT count(*)::text FROM platform_impact_actions WHERE revision_id=11 AND status='applied') AS applied, (SELECT count(*)::text FROM platform_impact_actions WHERE revision_id=11 AND status='accepted') AS accepted_awaiting, (SELECT string_agg(e.key||'='||p.impact_class||'/'||p.action||'/'||p.status, ' ') FROM platform_impact_actions p JOIN experiments e ON e.id=p.experiment_id WHERE p.revision_id=11 AND p.impact_class<>'I0') AS non_i0, (SELECT max(started_at)::text FROM experiment_epochs) AS latest_epoch_start, (SELECT count(*)::text FROM experiment_versions) AS versions, (SELECT count(*)::text FROM experiment_epochs) AS epochs
